name: Editorial System Field
description: Upmarket nonfiction system cover: a restrained, systematic art field (grid, geometry, abstract structure) with a strong typographic title block. No characters, no stock-photo cliches.

layout.composition: Title block top-left on a modular 4-col grid; author bottom; art field occupies the lower ~60% full-bleed
layout.margins: 10% safe zone all edges; title anchored to first grid column

typography.hierarchy: Title largest and tight-tracked, subtitle secondary, author tertiary at bottom

palette.contrast: high contrast: near-black type on light field

prompt.art: Abstract editorial book cover artwork, no text. A systematic field of repeating geometric modules (rectangles, thin grid lines, halftone dots) forming a quiet but structured composition. Limestone-paper cream background, ink black and a single muted accent. A large calm negative space in the upper third reserved for a title. Convey {tone} through structure, not illustration. Genre: {genre}.
prompt.negative: no text, no letters, no people, no hands, no skyline, no cliched stock imagery, no watermarks, no borders around the whole canvas
prompt.roleRefs: Use the reference images as a style board: keep their palette, texture, and structural logic. Do not copy specific subjects or composition verbatim.

provenance.source: Derived from the Editorial System Field cover style in book-writer design/cover-templates
